body: Gameplay evidence captured on Windows BYOND 516.1681 at ad0c9ce9847dbad62fe0d636134250310cf5c95b, NOMADS 155x225x2. Replication: run tests/train_collision/run-game.ps1 -ByondBin <516.1681-bin> -Visual -TimeoutSeconds 900, connect Dream Seeker to the localhost port in startup.log, open Local Verification, choose Inspect local train probe, then Run local train collision. Two powered steam locomotives approach, one towing two flatbeds. Expected/observed: both stop adjacent at (27,22,1)/(28,22,1), health 995, automovement 0; followers track vacated tiles. Inspect responded after the first collision. The second unobstructed replay contains 25 timed native captures over about 11.8 seconds, encoded as video without synthetic imagery. Initial/final screenshots show the game and exact commit. The owned world was later terminated by the runner resource guard during a final refresh; the attached final image is the last clean frame captured before termination. Startup engine bad-reference diagnostics precede passing train probes and remain disclosed. This evidence does not establish the reported native production crash. No production actions were performed. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a81f0d80-d100-48e1-b7f6-f546e2d2eda8
